insight: Founded in 2013 by Matthew Zeiler, whose deep-learning model won that year's ImageNet (ILSVRC) image-classification challenge.
name: Clarifai
tagline: Full-stack AI platform for computer vision and LLMs.
description: Clarifai is a full-stack AI platform for building with unstructured image, video, text, and audio data. It pairs production computer-vision models — classification, detection, visual search — with a model hub for LLMs, plus data labeling, training of custom models, and inference, all behind one API and console. A free Community tier lets you discover and run models before moving to paid usage plans.

modelSupport.notes: Hosts and serves a catalog of vision and language models plus user-trained custom models behind one API.

edge: One of the longest-running production computer-vision platforms, spanning labeling, custom model training, and inference for vision and LLMs in a single stack.
pros: Model hub for vision and LLMs
cons: Broad platform has a learning curve

references.title: Nebius snaps up Clarifai's compute orchestration tech and talent
